sections.name: File setup, metadata, pct
sections.title: Imports, settings and percent helper
sections.what: Brings in helpers, data functions, tracking, display pieces, the dossier components and styles. Sets the page to load fresh and sets the tab title. Defines a percent formatter that rounds.
sections.why: Likely reason: the profile changes with each call, so it must not be stored as a copy.
sections.watch_out: The percent formatter rounds to whole numbers, so small differences disappear.

sections.name: AlterEgoPage
sections.title: Locked and revealed file
sections.what: Requires sign-in, loads the profile, creates a share token only if the file is revealed, records a one-time reveal, and draws either the locked message with progress or the revealed file with evidence, axes and share control.
sections.why: The page text says the file opens only after 10 graded calls.
sections.watch_out: The 10 call threshold is written in the text, so changing the rule means changing the copy too.

summary: The Alter Ego page: shows a locked file until ten graded calls, then reveals the fan's style profile and share options.
purpose: Gives a fan a personal summary of how they call.
why: The page text says the profile is built only from how the fan calls, and the file opens after 10 graded calls.
how: Requires sign-in and loads the Alter Ego. If revealed, gets a share token and records a one-time reveal event. Draws a header, then either a locked message with progress, or the revealed file with evidence, axis scores, a privacy note and a share control.
inputs: The signed-in user, the Alter Ego data and the share token.
outputs: A locked page with progress, or the revealed dossier.
risks: The share card shows the display name and Alter Ego label, as the privacy note says. Percentages are rounded to whole numbers.
debug: If the file stays locked, check the graded call count. If the share link is missing, check alterEgoShareToken. If the reveal event repeats, check trackOnce.
